Sulbatai returns to India after earning belittlement from her daughter-in-law for her demeanour. So, when her son requests her to return to the USA, she strives to prove her worth.
Jayram, a police constable, is a simpleton who is mocked by his seniors. His mother, Mogarabai, cannot tolerate the humiliation her son is subjected to and secretly helps solve every case.
